title: GokuNEmu: \(P_\mathrm{lin,tot}\)
text:
https://github.com/astro-YYH/GokuNEmu
https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.07177
(GP version: https://github.com/astro-YYH/GokuEmu; https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.06296)
Supports \(N_\mathrm{eff} \alpha_s \nu w_0 w_a \mathrm{CDM}\) cosmologies.
In the Goku simulations, neutrino masses are assumed to follow the normal hierarchy, rather than three degenerate masses as in many other emulators. For small total masses (Σmν ≲ 0.2 eV), this difference leads to small but non-negligible deviations, which should be taken into account when comparing results.
\(N_\mathrm{eff}\) and \(\alpha_s\) are also input parameters; because DE2 does not vary them, they are fixed at \(N_\mathrm{eff}=3.044\) and \(\alpha_s=0\).

In the Goku simulations, neutrino masses are assumed to follow the normal hierarchy, rather than three degenerate masses as in many other emulators.
